comparison.objective: Insert a loaded sheet pan into a rack slot while preventing rack motion; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: One-hand rack bracing plus guided planar slot insertion versus small-tool alignment, fine rotation, locking torque, and iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Pan must occupy the second slot while rack translation stays within 40 mm and the end state holds 1 s; candidate requires two safe impacts with ≤12 mm travel and no drift or hard-stop contact.
comparison.reason: Constrained insertion into a mobile rack is not damper adjustment; bracing is only a shared generic primitive.
